pull_request.title: Calorimeter: select restored LAr as the EM working baseline
pull_request.head: codex/restored-lar-em-baseline
pull_request.body:
The user selects the **restored LAr design as the EM working baseline**. Default tracker+ECAL export now explicitly selects the validated 1.8 mm Pb / 1248-period barrel and 650 mm turbine endcaps through a recorded selection manifest. Si–W remains available as a comparison. Historical original/dense controls and all calibration/response evidence are preserved.

**Merge order: #147 → #148 → #149 → this PR.** All three existing drafts are stacked with ordinary merges, and nine newly closed task-parent turns are now accounted once in their original canonical journals, alongside existing child accounts. Individual public/visible interaction records and cumulative token previews pass locally. Current active baseline/reduced-gap work is excluded until finalized.

This baseline retains a **1000 mm warm-envelope barrel/endcap gap**: |z|4100→5100 mm. The requested 400 mm-gap variant follows in a separate PR on top, with explicit service-route assumptions and its own checks.

Fresh restored barrel/endcap XML and materials match the validated model byte-for-byte. Systems0–7/10/11 and 3,182,528 logical ECAL channels are retained. Current R–Z input/page/PNG/SVG now reflect the restored envelopes and shifted HCAL context. The older FCAL/collar rear routing needs reassessment; ECAL-only calibration identities are not automatically transferred to the tracker+ECAL union.

![Selected LAr baseline](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/7a9da4490f3bbe89f9d55fbfcadc795a3889139b/docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-002-restored-rz.png?raw=true)

[Selection and limits](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/restored-lar-em-baseline/docs/design/inputs/ECAL-baseline-selection-2026-11-18.md) · [Reproduction and identity receipt](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/restored-lar-em-baseline/docs/validation/lar-em-baseline/README.md)

Validation:8 composition tests pass, exact restored component identities pass, source-verified tracker overlay/current layout inspected, tracker factories/catalogs built under the reverified existing DD4hep/ROOT runtime. The full native tracker+ECAL union passed: ten systems, expected roots/IDs, **zero overlaps at1e-5mm** (seed114). Exact source/artifact/library hashes and the completed native receipt are retained. Independent SysArch review of7a9da4490f3bbe89f9d55fbfcadc795a3889139b found no material interface/provenance blocker; source identities, current/historical layout, artifact/calibration scope and byte-identical SVG were checked. No new shower-performance or engineering acceptance claim; design lifecycle states remain unchanged.

Tracking: TASK-CALO-BASELINE-RESTORE, DES-026/032/033. Draft for review; no main merge or ready-for-review action.
